plan.title: Recreate Closed RFQ with 30-Minute End Time

steps.note: Open the API-prepared closed RFQ's buyer summary page as required for prepared-state cases.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu and choose Recreate Order.
Confirm the Recreate Order popup is open before configuring it.

args.goal: In the Recreate Order popup, choose 30 Mins under Event End Time Duration, keep Evaluation Duration at 30 Mins, leave scheduling disabled, click Create Order, and stop on the newly created live event screen showing the recreated product details and Bidding Ends At.

steps.note: Perform and observe the popup configuration and creation flow that has no dedicated catalog action.
Confirm the resulting live event screen exposes the expected bidding end-time information.
